ap2_compliance_assessment.methodology: Keyword-signal scan of repository files — a checklist starting point, not a certification, audit, or legal/compliance advice.

dispute_readiness.represent_vs_refund: Business decision — follow your operator's dispute policy. AXIS does not publish win-rate estimates.

checks.name: sca_readiness
checks.title: SCA / 3DS2 Readiness
checks.remediation: 3DS2/PSD2 authentication with a working exemption/frictionless path detected — keep exemption thresholds current with your acquirer.

checks.name: ap2_mandate_validity
checks.title: AP2 Mandate Validity
checks.remediation: Mandate has an identifier and a spend/time bound — keep enforcing max_amount/expiry on every mandate.

checks.name: tokenization_posture
checks.title: Tokenization Posture
checks.remediation: Raw PAN storage antipattern detected — remove raw card-number persistence and replace with network-tokenized (VTS/MDES/DPAN) references immediately.

checks.name: ce3_readiness
checks.title: Compelling Evidence 3.0 Readiness
checks.remediation: CE 3.0 readiness signals present across 2+ dimensions — keep collecting prior-transaction and device/IP evidence for every order.

checks.name: dispute_rail_wiring
checks.title: Dispute Rail Wiring
checks.remediation: Dispute rail fully wired (dispute detection + network rail + evidence submission) — keep SLA timers current with card-network deadlines.

checks.name: idempotency_receipt
checks.title: Idempotency & Receipt Hygiene
checks.remediation: Idempotency-key usage and receipt/txn_id emission both detected — keep enforcing idempotency on every charge path.

checks.name: budget_negotiation
checks.title: Budget Negotiation Conformance
checks.remediation: Budget header and lite/mode negotiation both detected — keep the reduced-price path in sync with pricing changes.

checks.name: refund_cancel_path
checks.title: Refund / Cancel Path
checks.remediation: Refund/reversal and cancel/void paths both detected — keep both in sync with your mandate lifecycle.

compliance.methodology: Deterministic static source-signal analysis of the submitted files — a checklist starting point, not a live compliance audit, PCI assessment, or card-network certification. This is NOT a certification. It cannot verify runtime behavior, real network-token enrollment, or cryptographically-signed mandates.

decision.rationale: Transaction amount (€20) is at or below the €30 low-value exemption threshold (PSD2 RTS Art. 11); SCA not required.
Acquirer transaction-risk analysis qualifies this €400 transaction under the €500 EBA RTS Art. 15 fraud-band cap; SCA not required.
No lighter SCA path applies to this transaction; a 3DS2 SCA challenge is required.
